show: The Goop Guide with Gwyneth Paltrow
titel: An Update on The goop Podcast

faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (megaphone vergibt je Abruf eine request_event_id, megaphone haengt ein timetoken an, Adresse traegt eine session_id, kein ETag und Cache-Control "max-age=0, no-cache, no-store", Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst megaphone.fm) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Gwyneth Paltrow thanks listeners and shares an update on the Goop Podcast.
kurzfassung: Gwyneth Paltrow reflects on recent discussions covering health, relationships, identity, and spirituality on the Goop Podcast. She announces a summer break while teasing a fresh look and new conversations for the upcoming fall season. Finally, she asks the audience for feedback regarding future guests and topics before promoting the Goop Holiday Gift Guides.
stichpunkte: Gwyneth Paltrow thanks the community for eight years of the Goop Podcast
Recent episodes explored health, relationships, identity, spirituality, and science
The podcast is heading into a temporary summer break
Next season promises a new look and unchartered conversational territory
Listeners are invited to submit preferred guests and topics for future shows
The team promotes the upcoming Goop Holiday Gift Guides featuring curated selections

clips.text: The show is taking a short seasonal pause, but preparations are underway for a redesigned format featuring previously unexplored topics upon return.

beschreibung:
The goop podcast is going on a summer break. Thank you so much to everyone who tuned in for conversations with thought leaders, creatives, and experts. I’m so grateful to everyone who has been part of this community. Our show will return soon with a new look, new guests, and even bigger conversations. I can’t wait to show you what we have in store. Stay tuned.
